title: CLEAR: Complex Learned Explicit Analytical Regularization for Ultra-Accelerated 4D Flow CMR Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2609.22950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While compressed-sensing regularizers enable interpretable reconstruction of 4D Flow CMR through transparent variational objectives, their hand-crafted nature is too restrictive under high acceleration. State-of-the-art learning-based approaches mitigate this, but typically encode regularization implicitly through unrolled network modules, which limits their interpretability. To address this limitation, we propose CLEAR, designed to combine the interpretability of compressed sensing with the flexibility of learned models. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first learned regularizer for a 4D reconstruction task. In the ultra-accelerated \(10\times\)--\(50\times\) regime of the CMRx4DFlow2026 challenge, CLEAR outperforms compressed sensing locally low-rank (LLR) and the popular variational network FlowVN, while using less than 10k parameters and preserving an interpretable regularization structure.

translated_title: CLEAR：用于超加速4D Flow CMR重建的复数学习型显式解析正则化
translated_abstract: 虽然压缩感知正则化器通过透明的变分目标实现了4D Flow CMR的可解释重建，但其手工设计的特性在高加速倍数下过于受限。最先进的基于学习的方法缓解了这一问题，但通常通过展开的网络模块隐式编码正则化，这限制了它们的可解释性。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了CLEAR，旨在结合压缩感知的可解释性与学习模型的灵活性。据我们所知，这是首个用于4D重建任务的学习型正则化器。在CMRx4DFlow2026挑战赛的10倍至50倍超加速设置下，CLEAR的性能优于压缩感知局部低秩（LLR）方法和流行的变分网络FlowVN，同时仅使用不到1万个参数并保持了可解释的正则化结构。
tldr: 提出了CLEAR——首个用于4D Flow CMR重建任务的学习型显式解析正则化器，它结合了压缩感知的可解释性与学习模型的灵活性，在10-50倍超加速下以不到1万个参数超越了LLR和FlowVN方法。
en_tdlr: CLEAR is the first learned explicit analytical regularizer for 4D Flow CMR reconstruction, combining the interpretability of compressed sensing with the flexibility of learned models, outperforming LLR and FlowVN at 10×–50× ultra-acceleration with fewer than 10k parameters.
